heading: Specially adapted housing assistive technology grant program

tree.heading: Authority to Make Grants.—
tree.text: The Secretary shall make grants to encourage the development of new assistive technologies for specially adapted housing.

tree.heading: Application.—
tree.text: A person or entity seeking a grant under this section shall submit to the Secretary an application for the grant in such form and manner as the Secretary shall specify.

children.text: Each grant awarded under this section shall be in an amount of not more than $200,000 per fiscal year.
For each fiscal year in which the Secretary makes a grant under this section, the Secretary shall make the grant by not later than April 1 of that year.

tree.heading: Use of Funds.—
tree.text: The recipient of a grant under this section shall use the grant to develop assistive technologies for use in specially adapted housing.

tree.heading: Report.—
tree.text: Not later than March 1 of each fiscal year following a fiscal year in which the Secretary makes a grant, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report containing information related to each grant awarded under this section during the preceding fiscal year, including—

children.text: the name of the grant recipient;
the amount of the grant; and

tree.heading: Funding.—
tree.text: From amounts appropriated to the Department for readjustment benefits for each fiscal year for which the Secretary is authorized to make a grant under this section, $1,000,000 shall be available for that fiscal year for the purposes of the program under this section.

tree.heading: Duration.—
tree.text: The authority to make a grant under this section shall begin on October 1, 2011, and shall terminate on September 30, 2026.
